name: Bijan
seo_title: BIJAN - 32 Reviews | Singapore's Only Wedding Review Site
seo_description: Rated 4.4/5 for venue, 4.1/5 for service, 4.6/5 for food from 7 couples & 25 guests: “We had our big day in February. Bijan and team made it the most unforgettable and memorable day. We really appreciate the effort of Bijan and team for making our event a success. Thank you Ken, Sangeetha, Naleen and Aiko, to name a few, for the great planning and coordination of our wedding. Thank you Ken for your assurance, explanation and advices. Having Bijan as our wedding location was indeed a good choice. We like the all-in-one concept as most, if not all of the wedding services were provided by Bijan from card, kompang, makeup artist, emcee, hantaran decos, photographer, videographer et cetera, and even a one night stay at a local hotel, depending on the package chosen. Even though it was all in one, they have various options for us to choose from. Ken, who was the main person in touch was very assuring and explained things in detail from the start and also gave us good advices as the planning went on. Bijan’s team coordinated and carried out the majlis very smoothly. Based on the timing that we chose, they gave a rough itinerary that we can adjust to our plan we had in mind. From the day we selected the package, every few weeks they updated various information for us to make the selections we needed to make like which mak andam we choose, which kompang we want, which emcee we would like, which hantaran and wedding cake design we liked, our song list, et cetera. As the wedding day neared, we confirmed and updated them our choices. The quality of the choices were also good. We were in good hands with our mak andam, Sha De Couture – Kak Danisha (for the bride) and Abang AJ (for the groom), who are a very experienced and professional couple. The wedding venue deco was lovely and I got to know that they change the deco every few months which I think is a good move. We got a chill emcee, Kak Marlissa, who was on the ball and could connect well with our guests. One of our main concerns when choosing a wedding service provider was food. Alhamdulillah many of our guests truly enjoyed the tasteful spread of food and many shared that they enjoyed the briyani dum and kambing golek. We are grateful that we engaged Bijan as our wedding service provider. We recommend future couples to consider engaging their services. Insha Allah it will be worth it. Regards, Talha & Zubaidah”

name: Raffles Town Club
seo_title: RAFFLES TOWN CLUB - 1 Reviews | Singapore's Only Wedding Review Site
seo_description: Rated 5/5 for venue, 5/5 for service, 5/5 for food from 1 couples: “WC: Valerie Personal opinion, RTC is def very under-rated, coz I couldn't even find any BTB support groups on FB/Tele! Was lucky enough to be recommended this venue and it was also available during my wedding date! Package is also very competitive, as I not only get complimentary night stay on my AD & the night after, i also got a free room stay for my helpers + complimentary breakfast & parking during my stay + $100 dining vouchers (we couldn't finish utilising the credits so we bought a bottle of red wine home 🙈) + my GDL/betrothal packages fully sponsored (saved me a good almost $1k!) Valerie was also very nice & accomodating, by allowing us to sign a package of just 100pax first (lower monetary committment) & allowed us to increase the pax count to 300 just 1 month before our AD. They also had other club facilities (such as mahjong room, bowling alley, pool/billard tables) available for us to book for our guests, which was one of the pushing factor for us to sign the venue immediately. Food was good when we went for our food tasting, and initially we mental-prep ourselves that the standard will probably drop on the AD since everything is cooked in bulk, but to our surprise, most of our guests feedbacked that the food was still good! Their bridal room is huge & very comfortable, more than enough space for the bride to move around in gowns + MUA to work around + helpers to pack/do any preps required, all in the same room + jacuzzi too 😏! Would reco this place as wedding venue if anyone asked for my review, like where do you find mahjong rooms/bowling alley at wedding venue to entertain your guests before your event starts?? 😂 Other points to note: - Location is very convenient: pretty centrally located at Stevens Road, 2mins fully-sheltered walk from Stevens MRT (only the Downtown Line was available during my AD, but now the TEL is also available). Wheelchair accessible as well. - Parking coupons available! - Toilets are also readily available around the banquet hall. - Banquet hall is pillarless with a straight march-in aisle! (PM me if you want some photos) - There is also a cafe available, where our guests who arrived early can chill at for coffee/tea (usually only open to club members, but guests can just state that they are attending our wedding event and they will be allowed to be seated)”

name: Alcove at Caldwell House
seo_title: ALCOVE AT CALDWELL HOUSE - 6 Reviews | Singapore's Only Wedding Review Site
seo_description: Rated 3.5/5 for venue, 5/5 for service, 4/5 for food from 1 couples & 5 guests: “Held my wedding here for 50guests here and had a wonderful time. Venue: Gorgeous environment with beautiful sunlight during the day. The venue did make clear to us before we signed the contract that the place is only accessible via stairs to the 2nd floor, and is not wheelchair-friendly. They do have suggestions for alternative solutions for wheelchairs which we chose to not engage, but it was entirely our choice to accept it or not. The bridal room was spacious and gorgeous. Place is clean and aircon was good. Food: Everything was delicious. I loved the Angel hair pasta and many of my guests praised the herbal chicken soup. Champagne and white wine was amazing as well. Service: The entire process from booking, planning, to the actual day required many details, but the planner from the venue guided me through it all while answering all my questions. Response was fast and concise, making the whole process stress-free. Actual day service by the ground staff was also impressive. Many guests commented that their drinks were refilled swiftly and I personally received so much help for minor details I’ve missed out. I felt their dedication and sincerity to making sure my special day ran smoothly. Price: The packages offered are reasonably priced with many inclusions that surprised me. As far as intimate weddings go, the venue and people went above and beyond what I expected in price, quality and service. Overall, my now husband and I fell in love and will continue to love this place as the perfect spot that hosted our wedding. We are grateful to everyone at the venue for their efforts and graciousness. Highly recommend!”

name: Straits Chinese Nonya Restaurant 土生坊正宗娘惹餐馆 (1953)
seo_title: STRAITS CHINESE NONYA RESTAURANT 土生坊正宗娘惹餐馆 (1953) - 13 Reviews | Singapore's Only Wedding Review Site
seo_description: Rated 5/5 for venue, 4.8/5 for service, 4.8/5 for food from 11 couples & 2 guests: “We held our ROM and lunch celebration for around 100 guests at Straits Chinese Nyonya Restaurant (Esplanade) on a Friday, and we couldn't be happier with how everything turned out! From the very start, the planning process was incredibly smooth. Kelvin, the manager, was extremely responsive and helpful throughout, which gave us a lot of confidence leading up to the big day. The team was also flexible in arranging a reasonable payment schedule, and even offered discounted rates for our food tasting session beforehand – which we really appreciated. Additionally we had some relatives who were vegetarian and Muslims and Kevin ensured that they did not missed out as well! We chose this restaurant for several reasons: The food was delicious – flavourful but not overly oily or salty. We were able to share our preferences and the kitchen tailored the buffet menu accordingly. There was a great variety of dishes, and two big crowd favourites were the durian pengat and dry laksa! Convenient location – just a short, fully sheltered walk from both MRT and bus stops. As a bonus, the ROM registry was just upstairs, which made things very convenient for getting our certificate printed right before the event! The traditional Peranakan interior was beautifully maintained, perfect for colourful photos and something that our older family members really enjoyed. On the actual day, the team was on the ball and very responsive. Guests got their food and drinks promptly, the AV setup was a breeze, and the team was proactive in helping with logistics throughout. They even arranged carpark tickets for us as requested. We received so much positive feedback from our guests, and honestly, we have no regrets celebrating our wedding here. The atmosphere was comfortable, casual, and relaxed – perfect for a meaningful celebration with our loved ones. Thank you again to Kelvin and the team at Straits Nyonya! We’ll definitely be back for more yummy food soon. 😊”

seo_description: Rated 5/5 for venue from 1 couples & 1 guests: “We booked Highfive event space for our wedding after party (about 10months in advance) and it was generally a good experience with Highfive event space! Most event space allow booking only at 6pm onwards, which isn’t ideal. The event space is also relatively flexible, allowing storage of alcohols and our stores in their storage room for a night to ease our load.
